decisions.reason: The click-in track adapter builds directly on existing track and lighting know-how, so the firm can easily interpret results and improve it.
LED luminaires are core to the firm's lighting knowledge, enabling strong absorptive capacity and learning.
The home automation server box leverages existing home automation and planning software capabilities, though it is less closely related to core lighting.
The luminaire family is within the firm's established design and engineering strengths, allowing effective learning and improvement.
